subject: Controls orientation workshop — SOC2 / pen test / DPA prep

Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Intro + request: orientation session for SOC2 / pen test / DPA review

Laura —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We’re kicking off our vendor intake for Redwood and would like to schedule a controls orientation session to cover: SOC 2 scope, any planned pen test touchpoints, and DPA questions (data flows, retention, and logging). Goal is a single 60–90 minute session where our InfoSec + procurement folks can ask architecture and controls questions and collect any immediate evidence or links.

High-level ask: can you propose 3 time options next week (US eastern preferred) and a short attendee list from your side (roles only is fine)? We have to lock something this week.

A few constraints:
- Prefer weekdays between 13:00–17:00 ET
- We’ll need a shared Drive link for any evidence and a contact for a follow-up SOC2 evidence handoff

Thanks — copying our security alias for visibility.

Jonah Perry
Sr. Security Engineer, AcmeBank
jonah.perry@acmebank.com

Proposed slots (all ET):
- Wednesday 2026-12-16, 14:00–15:15
- Thursday 2026-12-17, 15:30–16:45
- Friday 2026-12-18, 13:00–14:15 (we can also extend to 90 min if requested)

Attendees from Redwood (roles):
- Laura Bennett — Head of Customer Security (will run the session)
- Camila Reyes — Solutions Engineer (controls walkthrough + evidence owner)
- Ben Carter — Compliance Engineer (pen-test handoff and ops questions)

We’ll drop a short evidence index and a one-page SOC2 snapshot ahead of the call — I’ll attach the deck and an evidence index for your intake folder. Please confirm which of the three slots works best and whether you want a calendar invite or a Teams link.

Best,
Laura Bennett
